documents_expected.why: request for proposals: priorities, eligible uses, applicants, deadlines, reporting
reference copy of the application: required answers and the shapefile

eligibility.rule: Small and mid-sized land trusts that follow the Land Trust Alliance's Standards and Practices
eligibility.quote: Small and mid-sized land trusts (preferably with 15 or fewer full-time staff) that have adopted the Land Trust Alliance's Standards and Practices

eligibility.rule: Within the Fund's New England eligibility area
eligibility.quote: Be located within the Eligibility Area shown in the New England Due Diligence Fund map

eligibility.rule: Fee acquisition only, not conservation easements
eligibility.quote: This funding cannot support conservation easement transactions.
alt_quotes: Pertain to acquisition of the fee simple interest in property (i.e. not conservation easements)

eligibility.rule: Pre-contract diligence only; no reimbursement of costs already paid
eligibility.quote: Funds cannot be used to reimburse for prior expenses.
alt_quotes: Reimbursements for diligence activities already paid for at the time of application

documents.quote: Applicants will also be required to submit a shapefile for the project.
alt_quotes: Provide a shapefile of the in a compressed .zip folder.

effort.step: Apply online in Foundant by a quarterly deadline
alt_quotes: All proposals must be submitted on Foundant, OSI's grant management platform.

after_award.quote: Grantees will be expected to provide brief, informal status updates to OSI as the project develops over the 24-month period following the grant award.

notes: Up to $25,000; quarterly rounds through fall 2027 (Sept 25 and Dec 18, 2026; March 12, June 11 and Sept 10, 2027). The next due date after the reading is December 18, 2026. Awardees later give a W-9 and wiring details (not a first-step document). The privacy page in the gathered set is noise.
